STITCH CRITICAL PATH
Algorithm wall_clock_active_leaf_v1: at each instant of the root span, the deepest span active on the synchronous path is critical; among parallel children the one ending last wins. A remote call's server node also owns its client's interval, so network time counts toward the callee. Segments cover the root's wall time exactly; a parent's own time between children is its self time. Producer/consumer and link relationships are excluded.
share = this node's critical time / all root wall time. ms/req = critical time per root request. mean and p95 are over the traces where the node was critical (on-path).
